title: The full Claude Desktop experience on AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Foundry
why_it_matters: Anthropic brings the full Claude Desktop experience to all three major clouds — AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Foundry. This closes the gap for enterprise teams locked into specific cloud providers and removes the last major deployment friction.
action: Check availability for your cloud provider

title: PP-OCRv6 on Hugging Face: 50-Language OCR from 1.5M to 34.5M Parameters
why_it_matters: PaddlePaddle drops PP-OCRv6 on HuggingFace: 50 languages, models from 1.5M to 34.5M parameters. The tiny model sizes make this viable for edge and mobile deployment where multimodal LLMs are overkill for document extraction.
action: Try it for your OCR pipeline — especially if latency matters

action: Update Claude Code and try `claude mcp login`
